overview: Darshan at Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath by helicopter — the four Himalayan shrines in a comfortable six-day pilgrimage.
inclusions: Round Trip Helicopter ride from Dehradun to the Char Dham shrines.
Accommodation @ Dehradun on the Arrival Day, just to unwind & get ready for your Yatra. Only
Accommodation for 5 nights: Accommodation at Dehradun on MAP Basis, and 01 night at each
Vegetarian Jain food can be arranged at the hotels if requested in advance during the booking process.
Local Sight Seeing with our guides at all four destinations.
Palki or Pony at Yamunotri - subject to availability.
Shri Kedarnath ji helicopter shuttle services: Sersi Kedar - Sersi.
Local transportation at all the Dhams on SIC basis.

Passangers are advised to book evening flights/Trains departing after 06:00PM, while returning back from Dehradun as due to weather/Operational reasons there might be delay in reaching back Badrinath to Dehradun.
VIP Darshans are subject to the orders issued by the temple authorities and State government.

In view of our helicopters' weight-carrying capacity, Diamond Hospitalities reserves the right to shuffle passengers between helicopters to manage the right weight for Life safety and hills flying CAR Section 08 Regulation of India. Therefore, passengers travelling together may not be accommodated in the same helicopter flight.
